The Baby Boom Generation is a demographic cohort most commonly defined as those born between 1946 and 1964, a period that began immediately after World War II.  
This was a time of increased birth rates in many countries, particularly the United States.  
The term does not refer to people born before WWII, nor does it mean they had an unusually large number of children or that they raised children in small villages.
